description: Adds a new page to the document. Ideal for designing multi-page catalogs, product lookbooks, brochures, magazines, and pitch decks.

copyCurrent.description: Whether to clone existing canvas content to the new page as a starting template

height.description: Page height in pixels (defaults to current canvas height)

switchNow.description: Automatically switch active canvas view to the newly created page

title.description: Title or label for the page (e.g. "Page 2 - Products Grid", "Features", "Back Cover")

width.description: Page width in pixels (defaults to current canvas width)

name: pages_add
